title: Only one product in the world is completely yours. And why it’s worth losing £10.

blocks.html:
This talk reveals three transformative insights that have changed my perception of product management and brought joy to my professional journey. The presentation will provide a personal, unique and concise perspective on product management from a seasoned professional with over 15 years of experience.

Everyone is a product manager in some way. Even though we are all different. We look differently or earn differently. But neither the way we look nor the job title - that determines our salary - defines who we are as product captains. True success lies in our ability to learn from life’s lessons. This presentation is intended to be a concrete and inspiring message for product people, those planning development in this area, and the wider IT world.
